cases.name: inline prime loop/single-line quote
cases.script: for n in $(seq 2 100); do d=2; p=1; while [ $((d*d)) -le $n ]; do if [ $((n%d)) -eq 0 ]; then p=0; break; fi; d=$((d+1)); done; [ $p -eq 1 ] && printf '%s ' "$n"; done; echo
